Om, and that is the ruling (prashasana). Om. 1/3/11.

That ruling (prashasana) is said to be steadfastness (dhriti), as indicated by the statement: “Gargi, the sun and the moon abide, established in the ruling of this imperishable (akshara).” And that ruling is that of Vishnu alone, as stated in the Shruti: “The seven half-embryos (sapta-ardha-garbha) of the universe abide in the directions, in the law (dharma) of the seed (reta) of Vishnu”; and “With the four (directions) and with ninety names, the wheel (chakra) does not deviate from its course (vyatiravivipat).” Also, as stated in the following: “There is one Ruler (Shasta); there is no second Ruler. Him, whom I hold in my heart, I declare to be here”; and “O King, it is not only for you, but also for the strength of the offerings (balinam) and for the others (apresham), that He is the Ruler.”
